schema: Lumen persistent memory store — Co-Architect update

memories.content: Lumen uses a Vulkan-backed WebGPU rendering pipeline with compute shaders for AI inference. The render loop is event-driven, not frame-rate capped.
AURORA-AXIS routing uses forward-only intent classification with bounded risk evaluation. Four interpretation classes: statistical_analysis, trend_forecasting, anomaly_detection, root_cause_analysis.
Agent Booster: Lumen integrates with external agent frameworks via a standardized agent protocol. Agents can request rendering, computation, and data access through the harness.

AURORA-AXIS Evaluation Harness provides synthetic benchmarking with four baselines (SinglePassLLM, ClarificationAgent, NaivePlannerExecutor, AuroraAxis). Supports drift recovery testing and Phase 2 human evaluation export.
